detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same 24-year-old Chinese man throughout, same face, same short black hair, same faded pale-blue shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm over dark grey work trousers. The camera holds a static shot. Seen from behind, his head is already turned to the left with a sliver of cheek showing; it holds there for a beat, then rotates slowly back toward the depth of frame until only the back of his head is left; his shoulders stay still and the backpack strap shifts a centimetre. The speaker (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, even and unhurried, the voice comes from off-screen while nobody in frame moves their lips,: <d>[Chinese] 我以全校第一的成绩考上夏国地质大学资源勘察专业。</d> while their lips remain completely closed. a distant taxi tout calling, the words blurred by distance. His head turns back to the right and settles aimed at the road in the depth of frame; the heated air warps the far buildings behind him. The speaker (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, the pitch lifting slightly on the last phrase, the voice comes from off-screen while nobody in frame moves their lips,: <d>[Chinese] 大学毕业的第一件事，就是飞到这里。</d> while their lips remain completely closed.

overall_soundscape:
A distant taxi tout calling, the words blurred by distance.
